items.title: BumaStemra Officially Takes Legal Action Against YourNeuroTune
items.excerpt: BumaStemra has taken legal action against YourNeuroTune for allegedly providing businesses with royalty-free music generated via Suno. Follow-up to the 11-25 ultimatum card: the threat is now an actual legal action.
items.rationale: Follow-up with a concrete new action: the 11-25 threat has become filed legal action, a first collecting-society case against a Suno-based background-music supplier.

items.title: Musixmatch launches enhanced Musixmatch Pro For Artists platform
items.excerpt: Musixmatch Pro for Artists expands beyond lyric distribution with enhanced AI-powered lyric transcription and time-sync tools, fan engagement analytics and lyric merch sales; MBW reports optional AI licensing is coming soon. (Published time from Google News index; page shows November 26th 2026.)
items.rationale: New product release artists can use right away: AI lyric transcription/time-sync plus an opt-in AI licensing option on the way.

items.title: Mooer GTRS Wing 1000: Intelligent Headless Guitar with NAM!
items.excerpt: Mooer's new headless 'intelligent' guitar adds support for A1 and A2 Neural Amp Model captures, imported via GTRS Studio, alongside its onboard G200 SmartBox effects, wireless and USB-C DAW recording.
items.rationale: A separate hardware launch (a guitar, not the 11-22 Future Flex modeler) that puts neural amp captures inside the instrument itself.

items.title: The AI revolution is coming for your electronic instruments
items.excerpt: A new era of AI-assisted modding has arrived; MusicRadar talks to Elektron and Akai about the opportunities and challenges for hardware instrument makers when users can rewrite firmware with AI coding tools like Claude.
items.rationale: Elektron and Akai speak on the record about AI-coded firmware mods. The orchestrator assigned this trend to music only, and it adds new manufacturer positions beyond the 10-29 Akai MPC card.

items.title: Guitarist George Lynch on his 'very strange' session for an AI track
items.excerpt: Ex-Dokken guitarist George Lynch says he unwittingly played a session on an AI-generated progressive track with never-repeating changes, calling it impressive and strange and asking why they wanted a human at all.
items.rationale: A fresh, first-hand account of human session players being hired onto AI-generated tracks without knowing it, which is a new labour angle.

https://www.digitalmusicnews.com/2026/11.new_action: BumaStemra has now formally taken legal action against YourNeuroTune (the 11-25 card only reported a threat/ultimatum).
